default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-678.title: Vortex indicator cross
E-678.hypothesis: VI+ over VI- measures which side's bar-to-bar excursions dominate; a cross with a margin marks directional control that trend followers and stop orders extend.

E-679.title: MFI oversold/overbought exit
E-679.hypothesis: Volume-weighted RSI leaving an extreme means forced sellers/buyers are exhausted; take the reversal.

E-680.title: KAMA slope turn
E-680.hypothesis: The adaptive average ignores noise and only turns when efficient movement appears; a turn with price on the new side signals a new directional leg.

E-681.title: Elder-ray pullback turn
E-681.hypothesis: In a rising EMA, bear power (low minus EMA) turning up from below shows sellers failing to push under the trend average; buy the turn (mirror for sells).

E-682.title: Regression slope t-stat break
E-682.hypothesis: A statistically strong linear trend over a window (large slope t-stat) means persistent one-sided flow; follow its first crossing of the threshold.

E-683.title: Heavy-volume rolling-VWAP cross
E-683.hypothesis: A cross of the rolling VWAP on above-typical volume, with the VWAP itself sloping that way, means the recent average cost basis is being reclaimed by active participants.

E-684.title: EMA ribbon full alignment
E-684.hypothesis: When price and three geometric EMAs line up in order, short, medium and long horizons agree; the first bar of alignment starts a trend leg.

E-685.title: Converging triangle break
E-685.hypothesis: Lower highs and higher lows with a shrinking range compress resting orders at both edges; the close beyond the recent half-window edge releases it.

E-686.title: Heavy-volume doji absorption break
E-686.hypothesis: A high-volume bar with a tiny body means large orders absorbed the flow without moving price; a close beyond its range shows which side was absorbed and follows.
